dataset.name: TRUSTLINE synthetic text-only pilot

split_config.name: trustline-synthetic-v1-grouped-seed-20261111
split_config.method: SHA-256 rank scenario-family names with the fixed seed, then hold out 20% of families within each label stratum (rounded to nearest family). All variants remain together.
split_config.warning: This is a reproducible re-partition of the existing authored synthetic pilot, not a newly collected or blind external validation set.

dataset.provenance: Original synthetic transcripts; no audio or personal recordings.

evaluation.method: Rules-only classification from deterministic risk result; MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL counts as a warning.

keyword_only.description: Naive multilingual credential-token baseline run on authored reference transcripts. It is not an audio, ASR, or production pipeline measurement.

evaluation.transcription_failure_note: Unavailable: this corpus contains synthetic text and no audio/transcription stage.

transcription_plus_keyword.reason: The corpus has reference text but no audio or ASR outputs; using reference text would not measure transcription.

ai_only.reason: No live Cohere calls are made by the offline benchmark.

hybrid.reason: Provider credentials/network are not assumed in automated evaluation.

full_contextual_pipeline.reason: This offline text corpus does not contain consented audio or provider-produced predictions.

full_audio_to_guidance.reason: Dataset is synthetic text-only and contains no audio.

limitations: Synthetic author-written text is not representative of real calls or ASR errors.
The rule set and corpus share an authoring context; this pilot is exploratory, not independent validation.
The grouped held-out split contains seven scenario families; record-level Wilson intervals do not account for within-family dependence.
This is a deterministic re-partition of the same authored pilot, not a newly collected or blind independent validation set.
AI-only, hybrid, transcription, and full-pipeline metrics are unavailable rather than inferred.
